description: Edit a message this bot sent: give new text, new buttons, or both; at least one is required. The new text must fit one Telegram message. Returns chat_id and message_id, with unchanged true when the message already looked like that.

message_id.description: message_id from a telegram.event or from an earlier result.

chat_id.description: Chat to act in: chat.id from a telegram.event, or a public @username. Omit it only for the configured home chat or the single allowed user.

text.description: Replacement text, Markdown unless format says otherwise.

format.description: How the text is written: markdown (default), plain text, or Telegram HTML.

link_preview.description: Show a preview of the first link; omit to keep the interface setting.

buttons.description: Inline keyboard as rows of buttons. Each button has text and exactly one of data (at most 64 bytes, returned as a button event when pressed) or url (an http, https or tg link).
